summary: Russian forces launched a massive attack on Sevastopol resulting in a complete power outage. Ukrainian forces have liberated 745 sq km and 26 settlements in the Oleksandrivka direction since January. Significant drone activity is reported across multiple regions, including over 1,000 drones shot down by Russian forces in the last 24 hours.
key_points: Russian forces conducted a massive attack on Sevastopol causing a total power outage in the city (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
The Russian Armed Forces struck a fuel depot in the Kyiv region using precision-guided weapons and drones (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Russian forces destroyed a fuel depot, a tanker, a cargo ship, and a Ukrainian patrol boat in Odessa, Chornomorsk, and Ochakiv (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Ukrainian forces liberated 745 sq km and 26 settlements in the Oleksandrivska direction between January and August (Source: @UkraineNow/83394).
Russian forces dropped FAB high-explosive aerial bombs on a bridge in the Krasnolimansk direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
The Russian Ministry of Defense reported 193 Ukrainian UAVs shot down during the day (Source: @tass_agency/390186).
Russian forces struck a repair and recovery train and a locomotive in the Odessa region (Source: @tass_agency/390183).
The 11th Tank Brigade of the 'North' Group of Forces liberated the settlement of Vodyanoye (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).

sections.executive_summary: A massive attack on Sevastopol has caused a complete power outage in the city. Russian forces are utilizing FAB high-explosive bombs in the Krasnolimansk and Druzhkovka directions. Ukrainian forces have reported significant territorial gains in the Oleksandrivka direction, reclaiming 745 sq km since January.

points: Ukrainian forces have liberated 745 sq km and 26 settlements across Dnipro, Donetsk, and Zaporizhzhia regions during the offensive in the Oleksandrivka direction (Source: @UkraineNow/83394).
The 'Skelya' regiment is transitioning to the operational command of the 'Azov' corps (Source: @UkraineNow/83412).
Ukrainian forces are working to restore a bridge in the Krasnolimansk direction while facing FAB bomb strikes (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
President Zelensky has rejected the possibility of territorial concessions to Russia in the Donbas (Source: @UkraineNow/83398).
Ukraine is launching a campaign to improve its image in Poland by highlighting historical alliances (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32423).
Russian forces struck a repair and recovery train and a locomotive in the Odessa region (Source: @tass_agency/390183).
Russian forces are dropping FAB high-explosive bombs on a bridge in the Krasnolimansk direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Russian forces are conducting heavy bombing in Druzhkovka, targeting shelters and drone operator stations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
The Russian Ministry of Defense reported 193 Ukrainian UAVs were shot down during the day (Source: @tass_agency/390186).
Russian forces are planning to remove border zones between occupied territories and the Rostov and Voronezh regions (Source: @UkraineNow/83410).
In the Krasnolimansk direction, Russian forces are dropping FAB bombs on a bridge being restored by Ukrainian forces (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Assault units of the 11th Tank Brigade of the 'North' Group of Forces liberated the village of Vodyanoye (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Heavy FAB bombing is occurring in Druzhkovka, targeting personnel shelters and drone operator stations (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Fighting is focused on logistics in the Krasnolimansk direction (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).

The 'North' Group of Forces reported the redeployment of Ukrainian reinforcements in the Sumy direction, including the 22nd Separate Mechanized Brigade and 38th Separate Marine Brigade (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
UAVs were reported heading towards Nizhyn from the southeast and north of Kholmiv in the Chernihiv region (Source: @kpszsu/72669).
A massive attack on Sevastopol resulted in a complete power outage in the city (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Russian forces struck a fuel depot, a tanker, a cargo ship, and a Ukrainian patrol boat in Odessa, Chornomorsk, and Ochakiv (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Fighting is occurring in Stepnogorsk, southern Primorskoye, Lukyanovskoye, and the direction of Yurkovka on the Zaporizhzhie front (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
FABs were used to strike a logistics hub between Cherepakhovka and Stepanovka in the Kherson region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Russian forces used precision-guided weapons and drones to strike a fuel depot in the Kyiv region (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
More than a thousand Ukrainian drones were shot down over Russian regions in the last 24 hours (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32417).
Two reactive 'Banderoľ' UAVs were reported heading towards Balakliia and Donetsk from the south (Source: @eRadarrua/105215).
A threat of ballistic missiles for the capital remains at a medium-to-high level (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70180).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is highly volatile due to increased Russian use of FAB high-explosive bombs in the Krasnolimansk and Druzhkovka directions. The massive attack on Sevastopol indicates a continued focus on targeting critical infrastructure and causing widespread power outages. The high volume of drone activity across multiple fronts suggests a sustained campaign of attrition.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine is focusing on territorial reclamation, having successfully liberated 745 sq km in the Oleksandrivka direction. Diplomatically, Ukraine is attempting to improve its image in Poland through historical alliances. Internally, the Ukrainian government has allocated over 2 billion UAH to support 179 frontline communities.
sections.intelligence_notes: The redeployment of the 22nd Separate Mechanized Brigade and 38th Separate Marine Brigade in the Sumy direction suggests Ukrainian efforts to stabilize lines following combat losses. Russian efforts to remove border zones between occupied territories and Russian regions indicate a strategic move to formalize the annexation of Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson.
